_readme: Terms that are CORRECTLY identical in every language QManager ships.
The passthrough check (lib/i18n/passthrough.ts) warns when a locale value is
byte-identical to the English source, which usually means the string was
copied and never translated. In this domain a lot of identical values are
legitimate: radio acronyms, SI units, protocol names, product names. Every
word listed here is stripped from a value before the check decides whether
Matching is case-insensitive, whole-token, after the value is split on
whitespace and punctuation. So "dBm" also covers "dbm", and listing "Cell"
would suppress it everywhere it appears -- keep entries specific.
Do NOT add a term here just to silence a warning. Add it only when the word
is genuinely untranslated in ALL five locales (en, zh-CN, zh-TW, it, id).
Anything that is merely a common loanword in one locale belongs in that
Tokens containing a digit (5G, IPv4, B12, n78, UCS-2) and short ALL-CAPS
acronyms (<= 6 chars: APN, PCI, SINR, EARFCN) are recognised automatically
